_doc: PT K35: a 3.5 mm thread-forming screw for thermoplastics (the PT type, works standard WN 1412), which forms its own thread in a plain hole: its own set, since its pilot follows its maker's rule and not a machine screw's. Thread and pan head from PSM International's sheet. The pilot, boss and depth are the maker's factors for moulded ABS, applied to the screw's diameter: no maker lists PLA or PETG, so they are community figures until measured on your printer. No tap, no nut. kind as in x1c.json.
name: pt_k35

torx.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/

thread_form.rule: A thread-forming screw for thermoplastics: a coarse thread with 30° flanks, which push the plastic aside and burst a boss less than a machine screw's 60°
thread_form.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/

thread.rule: The screw as it is sold: PT K35, 3.5 mm across its thread
thread.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/

major_diameter.rule: PT K35 outside diameter of the thread (d)
major_diameter.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same figures on Boellhoff's data sheet E 1412, https://eshop-cz.boellhoff.com/out/media/pdf/E_1412_Edelstahl_A2___en.pdf

root_diameter.rule: PT K35 root diameter of the thread (R)
root_diameter.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same figures on Boellhoff's data sheet E 1412, https://eshop-cz.boellhoff.com/out/media/pdf/E_1412_Edelstahl_A2___en.pdf

pitch.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same figures on Boellhoff's data sheet E 1412, https://eshop-cz.boellhoff.com/out/media/pdf/E_1412_Edelstahl_A2___en.pdf

pan_head.rule: PT K35 pan head diameter, cross recess (WN 1412). The Torx pan head is 6.9: variant torx
pan_head.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same figures on Boellhoff's data sheet E 1412, https://eshop-cz.boellhoff.com/out/media/pdf/E_1412_Edelstahl_A2___en.pdf

pan_head_height.rule: PT K35 pan head height, cross recess (WN 1412). The Torx pan head is 2.3: variant torx
pan_head_height.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same figures on Boellhoff's data sheet E 1412, https://eshop-cz.boellhoff.com/out/media/pdf/E_1412_Edelstahl_A2___en.pdf

pan_head_drive.rule: PT K35 pan head recess: Pozidriv or Phillips number 2. The Torx head takes T10: variant torx
pan_head_drive.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), dimensions, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/

pilot.rule: Hole for a PT K35 screw to form its thread in: 0.8 of its diameter, the maker's figure for ABS (0.75 for nylon and POM, 0.85 for polycarbonate). No maker lists PLA or PETG, and printed holes come out small: a starting figure, to measure on your printer
pilot.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), design recommendation, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same factors in Bossard's construction recommendations (01-2025), https://www.bossard.com/ie-en/knowledge-hub/resources/technical-information/construction-recommendations-for-fasteners/

pilot_depth.rule: Least depth of thread a PT K35 screw needs in the plastic: twice its diameter, the maker's figure for ABS
pilot_depth.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), design recommendation, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same factors in Bossard's construction recommendations (01-2025), https://www.bossard.com/ie-en/knowledge-hub/resources/technical-information/construction-recommendations-for-fasteners/

pilot_boss.rule: Least outside diameter of a boss round a PT K35 screw's hole: twice the screw's diameter, the maker's figure for ABS
pilot_boss.source: PSM International, PT series screws (WN 14), design recommendation, https://psmfasteners.com/product_guide/direct-screw-fixings-for-plastics-light-alloys-guide/pt-series/; the same factors in Bossard's construction recommendations (01-2025), https://www.bossard.com/ie-en/knowledge-hub/resources/technical-information/construction-recommendations-for-fasteners/
